title: Blu joins Pattern’s global portfolio as its first Middle Eastern brand
summary: Agreement is the first step in blu’s plans to take its best-selling shower filtration technology to Europe and North America
thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
contentHtml:
Dubai, United Arab Emirates, blu today became the first Middle Eastern brand in the history of Pattern (Nasdaq: PTRN) to join the global ecommerce accelerator’s portfolio. The Dubai-born wellness tech brand behind the blu Ionic Shower & Filter has sold more than one million products across the GCC and ranks number one in Showerhead Filters on Amazon.ae and in Shower Filters on noon.com/uae as at 17 August 2026. blu was built for international markets from day one, with Europe and North America as its first target markets. The move marks a milestone in that expansion — and reflects the rising influence of Middle Eastern innovation on the global consumer stage.

blu’s Founding Partners, Eng. Ahmed ElGibaly, CEO, and Lars Mourey, COO, said: “This agreement is a moment not just for blu, but for the Middle East. For 17 years we have built blu the hard way: self-funded, manufacturing our own products, and earning trust one shower at a time. The United Arab Emirates has been our strongest market throughout. Being the first Middle Eastern brand in Pattern’s portfolio reflects international confidence in what our part of the world can build. We look forward to bringing blu to customers across Europe and North America, while continuing to build here at home.”

David Quaife, Managing Director, Pattern MENA, said: “We are pleased to have signed an agreement with blu — the first brand from the Middle East to join our global portfolio. blu has established an exceptional track record of consumer trust, marketplace performance, and product innovation across the GCC, including the United Arab Emirates, and we see significant potential in bringing its products to customers in key international markets.”

The partnership advances the UAE’s ambitions in digital trade and homegrown brand-building, in line with the UAE Digital Economy Strategy, which targets doubling the digital economy’s contribution to GDP from 9.7% in 2022 to 19.4% within 10 years of the strategy’s launch. Taking a UAE-grown brand onto major international marketplaces reflects the country’s growing role as a hub for building, scaling, and exporting consumer businesses, connecting locally founded companies with global expertise and technology.

blu’s momentum rests on a broad review base: nearly 50,000 verified five-star reviews across Amazon, noon, Google, and Facebook — many of them written rather than star ratings alone. The brand also sits inside the top 3 of the parent Tools & Home Improvement category on Amazon.ae — ahead of everyday household staples — as at 17 August 2026. Demand is not confined to marketplaces: blu operates eight retail locations across the UAE, comprising dedicated stores in major malls and shop-in-shops in Carrefour, Géant, and Danube Home.

blu designs and manufactures all its own products and has launched 14 generations of its proprietary shower filtration technology since 2009. Its performance claims are supported by independent testing from internationally recognised laboratories including TÜV, SGS, and Eurofins, and its NMC filtration media is certified to NSF/ANSI 42. blu holds vendor agreements covering the Middle East and Africa with six international hotel groups — Accor, IHG, Marriott, Millennium, Minor Hotels, and Wyndham — and its products are used in nearly 100 hotels across the region, where they deliver a filtered shower for guests and support water- and energy-efficiency objectives.

Under the agreement, blu and Pattern will develop a phased acceleration and international expansion roadmap, combining blu’s product innovation and regional market expertise with Pattern’s capabilities in ecommerce technology, marketplace management, data analytics, and cross-border commerce. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

With the global wellness economy at US$6.8 trillion in 2024 and forecast to approach US$10 trillion by 2029, the partnership positions blu to scale internationally — and signals what UAE-born innovators can achieve on the global stage.

About blu

Founded in Dubai in 2009, blu is a wellness tech brand and the developer and manufacturer of the best-selling blu Ionic Shower & Filter. Built without external investment, the company combines proprietary filtration technology — 14 generations since launch — with in-house manufacturing and continuous research and development. blu supplies consumers, leading retailers, and nearly 100 hotels across the region. Its performance claims are supported by independent testing from internationally recognised laboratories including TÜV, SGS, and Eurofins, and its NMC filtration media is certified to NSF/ANSI 42. Each unit is fitted with a flow regulator from Neoperl, the German-Swiss flow-control specialist, which Neoperl states reduces water and energy consumption. For more information, visit www.bludubai.com.

About Pattern

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 77 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern's ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across more than 70 global marketplaces — including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, JD, and Mercado Libre.

Forward-Looking Statements

This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the laws of the United States, Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. Such forward-looking statements include all statements other than statements of historical fact, including but not limited to expectations regarding the blu and Pattern relationship, impacts thereof, international expansion and timing of any of the foregoing. Forward-looking statements are neither promises nor guarantees, are inherently difficult to predict, and involve known and unknown risks and uncertainties. Additional information regarding factors that could materially affect results and the accuracy of the forward-looking statements contained herein may be found in Pattern’s Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on March 6, 2026, Pattern’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, filed with the SEC on May 7, 2026, and in Pattern’s subsequent filings with the SEC.

“Best-selling” refers to the cumulative sales and review performance of the blu Ionic Shower & Filter: more than one million products sold across the GCC, and nearly 50,000 verified five-star reviews across Amazon, noon, Google, and Facebook.

Marketplace rankings, United Arab Emirates: #1 in Showerhead Filters and #1 in Handheld Showers on Amazon.ae, #3 in the parent Tools & Home Improvement category on Amazon.ae, and #1 in Shower Filters on noon.com/uae, each as at 17 August 2026. Marketplace rankings are refreshed by the platforms and may vary.

“Approaching US$10 trillion” refers to the global wellness economy, which reached US$6.8 trillion in 2024, up 7.9% year on year and double its 2013 size, and is forecast to grow 7.6% annually to US$9.8 trillion by 2029. Source: Global Wellness Institute, Global Wellness Economy Monitor 2025, published 19 November 2025: https://globalwellnessinstitute.org/industry-research/2025-global-wellness-economy-monitor/

The UAE Digital Economy Strategy target: launched in April 2022, the strategy aims to double the digital economy’s contribution to GDP from 9.7% in 2022 to 19.4% within 10 years. Source: UAE Government official portal: https://u.ae/en/about-the-uae/strategies-initiatives-and-awards/strategies-plans-and-visions/finance-and-economy/digital-economy-strategy

Retail footprint: eight blu retail locations in the UAE as at 17 August 2026, comprising dedicated stores in major malls and shop-in-shops in Carrefour, Géant, and Danube Home. Store list available from the media contact on request.

Laboratory testing: performance claims for the blu Ionic Shower & Filter are supported by independent testing from internationally recognised laboratories including TÜV, SGS, and Eurofins. The NMC filtration media used in the product is certified to NSF/ANSI 42. The NSF listing is held by Swiss Standard Co., Limited, a sister company under common ownership with blu Dubai, which manufactures the media under licence. NSF listing: https://info.nsf.org/Certified/DWTU/Listings.asp?Company=C0851998&Standard=042

Supporting documents: copies of the reports, and confirmation of the licensing relationship, are available from the media contact on request.

NSF standards: NSF/ANSI 42 is the standard for drinking-water treatment units addressing aesthetic effects, including chlorine reduction. NSF/ANSI 177 is the standard written specifically for shower filtration systems. blu’s NMC filtration media is certified to NSF/ANSI 42; the two standards differ in scope and are not directly equivalent.

Flow regulator: the blu Ionic Shower & Filter is fitted with a flow regulator supplied by Neoperl, a German-Swiss flow-control specialist founded in 1959, with its registered office in Reinach-Basel, Switzerland and production and research and development in Müllheim, Germany. Neoperl states that its products contribute to sustainability by reducing water and energy consumption. Source: https://www.neoperl.com/global/en/oem

Hotel supply: blu holds vendor agreements with six international hotel management groups, covering the Middle East and Africa: Accor, IHG, Marriott, Millennium, Minor Hotels, and Wyndham. blu products are installed in properties operated under brands including InterContinental, Crowne Plaza, Sofitel, Novotel, Fairmont, The Ritz-Carlton, W Hotels, and JW Marriott Marquis. Copies of the vendor agreements and a property list are available from the media contact on request.
